lines.en: I fly in the End's purple light.
My wing edges glow violet.

lines.zh: 我贴着浮空岛的下侧飞。
lines.en: I fly along the underside of the floating isle.

lines.zh: 我绕着末地城转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the End city once.
The shell on my back is heavy.

lines.zh: 我落到紫珀砖上，停一停。
lines.en: I settle on purpur brick a while.
I pass an end stone pillar.
My shadow is violet-black.
I slip through a tower window.

lines.zh: 我在虚空上方的气流里滑。
lines.en: I glide on the current above the void.

lines.zh: 我从一座塔飞到另一座。
lines.en: I fly from one tower to another.

lines.zh: 我顺着紫珀砖的缝往上。
lines.en: I rise along a purpur seam.
I hook a claw on the ledge corner.
I beat my wings and shift sideways.
I hang in a recess.
My wing membrane opens and closes.
There is almost no sound here.
I watch the maze below the tower.
Purple light slides over my back.

lines.zh: 我想起我该是别的样子。
lines.en: I recall I should be something else.
I retract halfway into my shell.
Wind rises from the void.

lines.zh: 我缩在末地塔的凹槽里等。
lines.en: I tuck myself into a notch of an End tower and wait.
I wait for a traveller to pass.

lines.zh: 我的壳上落了一点紫尘。
lines.en: A little purple dust settles on my shell.
I count the tower's floors.

lines.zh: 你身上的紫，也是从这里来的。
lines.en: The purple on you comes from here too.
I am watching you from above.
My shell matches the tower.

lines.zh: 你要是留下来，就得习惯虚空。
lines.en: If you stay, you must get used to the void.

lines.zh: 我扇了一下翅膀，紫光一闪。
lines.en: I beat my wings and purple flashes.

lines.zh: 你是来找城的，还是来找我的。
lines.en: Did you come for the city, or for me?

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在这里很显眼。
lines.en: Your armor stands out here.
I rarely see anyone.

lines.zh: 这里的风会把人推下去。
lines.en: The wind here pushes people off.
My shell is struck.

lines.zh: 我在空中打了个旋，稳住。
lines.en: I spin once in the air and steady.
I fly behind the beam.
It hurts, and my shell is thick.
Purple blood drips down.
That dropped me half a foot.
I caught the ledge again.
You struck my shell; well aimed.
My wings are trembling.

lines.zh: 我的壳很厚，紫血滴下来。
lines.en: My shell is thick; purple blood drips.
I like that glow.
I have flown over to it.
Purple things are best.
I bite into that speck of purple light.
Give me a little more of that glow.

lines.zh: 这东西不像末地的东西。
lines.en: This does not look native to the End.
I will hold it a while.
An End fruit? Hand it over.
You bumped the spot where I hang.
I dart up to the eave above.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我壳响了一声。
lines.en: The bump made my shell clack.
My weight cannot hurt you.
I circle half around your head.
Your shoulder met my shell.
I hang back in place.
The ledge here is narrow.
Do not come so close to the wall.
There are almost none of my kind here.

lines.zh: 我连自己的形状都不稳。
lines.en: Even my own shape is unstable.
The void is no place for that.

lines.zh: 你问得很轻，风就带走了。
lines.en: You asked lightly; the wind took it.
I retract into my shell.
I have only purple blood.
There was only one of me in that spawn.
That subject will not hold.
I fly to a higher tower.
Let us not speak of it.

lines.zh: 我这颗核心，能开动乱祭坛。
lines.en: This core can start the Altar of Turmoil.

lines.zh: 它掉进了虚空，我没抓住。
lines.en: It fell into the void; I missed it.
With it I fly crooked.
Too hard; I cannot break it.
I tuck it under my shell.
I carry it back to the ledge.
It glows; excellent.
I leave it on the window ledge.
Good; into the shell.
Something is moving below the tower.

lines.zh: 紫光里那道影子被你踩响了。
lines.en: Your step rang through the purple light.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在紫珀砖上很清。
lines.en: Your steps ring clearly on purpur.
Only the two of us on this floor.
I let go of the ledge.

lines.zh: 我的壳有点重，但我不慢。
lines.en: My shell is heavy, but I am not slow.
The wind carries your scent up.
You have looked up.
Good; I see you clearly.
I slip down along the tower wall.
You go in the door; I follow.
This floor has a ring corridor.
I circle above the purpur bricks.

lines.zh: 紫色的光照在我的壳上。
lines.en: Purple light falls on my shell.
You stepped back on the sill.
I am on the beam above you.
The brick under you is loose.
Wind pours through the window.
I drop slowly lower.
I dive at your head.

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，撞起来很响。
lines.en: My shell is hard and rings on impact.
You swat and I tumble.
I fly back to the beam.
I rake your eyes with my wings.
You back toward the window.
You struck the wall.

lines.zh: 我的壳撞在你肩上，弹开了。
lines.en: My shell hits your shoulder and bounces off.
You go; I hang back under the ledge.

lines.zh: 我从末地石缝里凝出来。
lines.en: I condense out of an end stone seam.
My spawning chance is small.
The shell forms first.
This is under the End city's ledge.

lines.zh: 紫光在我身上停了一下。
lines.en: Purple light rests on me a moment.
First I hang and look around.
The maze below the tower is deep.
Wind rises from the void; cold.

lines.zh: 我听见有别的东西在飞。
lines.en: I hear something else in flight.
Good; first I hide.
Fire catches my membrane and curls a corner.

lines.zh: 我从塔上一直落到紫珀砖上。
lines.en: I fall from the tower onto purpur.

lines.zh: 水在这地方很怪，我翅膀全湿。
lines.en: Water is strange here; my wings are soaked.
The blast throws me out the window.
An arrow punches through my membrane.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的壳发烫。
lines.en: That force heats my shell.

lines.zh: 末地没什么可吃，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Little to eat in the End; I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光在虚空上方亮了一下。
lines.en: The flash lights above the void.
I fall into the void, my shell still ringing.
